why: TSMC IR: Q3 2026 earnings conference Thu 2026-10-15 at 14:00 Taiwan time = 02:00 ET, before the US open. The baseline's 9-day 'cadence' is monthly revenue and other 6-Ks.
session_evidence: Conference at 14:00 Taiwan time / 2:00 a.m. ET on 2026-10-15, per investor.tsmc.com (https://investor.tsmc.com/quarterly-results). The ADR's first session to carry it is 10-15.
where_to_look: The Q4 guide and the 2027 pricing/capex commentary are the only unpriced lines, because Q3 revenue is already public from the monthly reports. Look at supply-chain pricing reports (DigiTimes, TrendForce on N3/N2 wafer price hikes for 2027).
Customer capex read-through: hyperscaler and Nvidia/AMD/Apple orders, CoWoS capacity reports
The ADR is -8.5% over 5 days into the print (baseline). Find what drove it (an ASML read-through on 10-15? a sector move?)
already_in_the_wire: Q3 revenue NT$1.49tn (~US$46.7bn), above the $44.6-45.8bn guide, from the September monthly report (https://www.kaohooninternational.com/?p=592325)
Q3 GM guide 65-67%, OM 56-58%; 2026 capex raised to $60-64bn in July (https://www.hl.co.uk/shares/stock-market-news/company--news/tsmc-lifts-outlook-as-q2-profits-surge-on-continued-ai-chip-boom)
trades_on: Capex and spend, against a beat. Q2's beat-and-raise fell about 2-4.6% as the market focused on the capex raise (https://www.proactiveinvestors.com/companies/news/1095573).
